messages:
Jesse: Heads-up: ACME reported missing audit logs for 2026-12-02 03:00-06:30 UTC after our key rotation. They see gaps in the export. Any immediate sense of scope? cc @Maya @Alex @Emily :warning:

IncidentBot: Incident created: INC-2026-4593 and assigned to Emily (oncall).

Emily: Looking into this now. Jesse can you paste the exact export command you used and an example missing event id?

Jesse: Sure — here is the curl we ran and one missing_event_id:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?tenant=t-acme&start=2026-12-02T03:00Z&end=2026-12-02T06:30Z' 
# response shows gaps, example missing_event_id: evt_9f3a
```

Alex: FYI we rotated key K-2026-main at 2026-12-02T02:45Z. Rotation was KMS-only; HSM was NOT involved. No planned infra change on the audit service. There is an open tracking ticket: ENG-EXPORTS-321 that mentions batch drops during rekey flows :eyes: https://redwood.internal/eng/ENG-EXPORTS-321

Maya: If those gaps could affect customers' compliance evidence we need to notify. Triage checklist: 1) scope (tenants affected), 2) exact duration per tenant, 3) whether exported logs contain customer identifiers/PII, 4) replay feasibility.

Jesse: Affected tenant: acme.com (t-acme). Duration approx 03:00–06:30 UTC (~3.5h). Missing entries include request_id and user_id in examples. When support attempted replays we got intermittent 504s from the export endpoint. I'll attach export logs to the incident.

Alex: Replay is possible for many blobs, but key rotation disrupted decryption for objects signed under the old key for ~2h. We restored decryption for most objects after rekeying. There's a backlog of raw blobs that we can attempt to reprocess. Risk: if a blob couldn't be decrypted at the time and key material isn't available, cleartext might not be recoverable. Need Security to confirm archived key availability.

Maya: Do not start wide reprocessing until Security confirms key access. If we can reprocess and restore full exports we can avoid broad customer notifications. If not, per policy we must notify affected customers with scope and remediation steps. Scheduling a sync in 30m. @Jordan please advise on legal messaging.

Jordan: Legal here — if the exports contain PII or are relied on for audits, we should notify customers ASAP with a measured message. Avoid language admitting unauthorized access. Suggested first message: short acknowledgement + what we're doing + ETA for next update. We need engineering to produce exact per-tenant windows. Also collect whether any export records were sent to third parties.

Emily: Action list I put in the incident: 1) Engineers evaluate replay feasibility and try a test reprocess (Alex). 2) Security confirm key material & whether HSM was used (Maya). 3) Support drafts customer-facing note and wait for legal sign-off (Jesse + Jordan). 4) Assign postmortem owner. ETA for first customer comms: 12 hours unless blockers. :thumbsup:

Alex: Quick tech note: old key material retention policy retained wrapped keys for 30 days; HSM was not used for this KMS key. I'll kick off a replay job on a copy (non-prod) to validate restoration path and report success/failure.

Maya: Confirmed: old wrapped key is present but access requires approvals. HSM was not involved. Security will provision temporary access for the replay test within ~2 hours and supervise.

Jesse: Draft customer note for review:
"We detected an interruption in audit export for your tenant between 2026-12-02 03:00 and 2026-12-02 06:30 UTC following a key rotation event. We are evaluating restoration options and will provide an update within 48 hours. We are not aware of any unauthorized access to your data. If you need immediate assistance, contact support@redwood.ai."

Jordan: Draft looks good. Two edits: change 'following a key rotation event' -> 'during a key rotation event' and replace 'We are not aware of any unauthorized access' with 'We are not aware of any evidence of unauthorized access' for caution. Also include link to support contact and the incident ID.

Jesse: Got it — will update and queue for legal sign-off, then send to acme's security contact. Incident logged as INC-2026-4593. Will update this channel after replay test.

Emily: Thanks all. Please add any test outputs to the incident and tag when replay job completes. Next update window: within 12 hours or earlier if restoration is proven. :eyes:
